changes.summary: Lens: LensDashboard gains an optional host-driven in-place edit mode (edit) over the live cards with drag/keyboard reorder, resize, card menu, Add report, Cancel/Save or Save draft/Publish reusing the composition draft, leave guard, conflict and proposal handling; a friendly empty state; chrome options to hide the title/description/header and a compact toolbar; ReportCompositionEditor now scopes the Lens tokens itself so hosts without a .lens-root render it styled.
